row.body: The clipboard is closed around a keyring. One key leaves a clean outline in the dust, while the page beneath the clip has torn away at the holes.
row.title: The keyring clipped over the empty page

sidecar.gloss: Keys remain where a page was torn from a clipboard.
sidecar.rival_reading: A field crew could move its notes and keys in a hurry when a test site closed; the torn page does not prove a warning was ignored.

row.body: the warning whistle and first-aid kit were sealed together but never opened. soot darkens the bundle; clean outlines show it was packed before the fire.
row.title: missing count beside the warning whistle

sidecar.gloss: A response bundle preserves a missing count, changed route, or erased identity.
sidecar.rival_reading: A farm-program crew could have counted routes, repacked tools, or removed ownership marks during hurried field work; the objects do not prove a concealed public response.
